description: The first stage's duplicate covering emissions are a document error before the later verbatim stage can run (engine §9.3, §11.4).

documents.a.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text (letter letter)
%rule letter char %emits $ :: A, $ :: A
%rule char "a" | "b"
```
documents.b.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text (pair pair)
%rule pair (prefix edge)
%rule prefix A %emits ε :: X
%rule edge ($n:nothing A) %emits ε :: Y, $n :: Z
%rule nothing ε
```
documents.c.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text ($u:u $w:w $z:z) %emits $u :: U, $w :: W, $z :: V

%rule u :- $.verbatim-text | (X Y Z)

%rule w :- $.verbatim-text | (X Y)

%rule z :- $.verbatim-text | Z

```
